value.rationale: The graph is the standard thagomizer matroid family and its complete all-frequency Walsh transform is a natural harmonic invariant. New exact rank and positive spectral condition combine with a nontrivial sharp projection norm increase under adding one shared spine edge, quantified by a central-binomial term asymptotic to sqrt(2/(pi n)), giving a mathematically motivated graph-perturbation comparison rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
